title: OARelatedWork: A Large-Scale Dataset of Related Work Sections with Full-texts from Open Access Sources
abstract: arXiv:2405.01930v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper introduces OARelatedWork: a dataset for related work generation from open-access sources. It is the first large-scale multi-document summarization dataset for related work generation, containing whole related work sections and full texts of cited papers. Its validation and test splits are constructed so that every source paper is available in full text, enabling controlled evaluation of full-text related work generation. The dataset includes 94 450 papers from multiple domains. With OARelatedWork, we aim to shift the field from generating parts of related work sections from abstracts only to generating entire related work sections from all available content. translated_title: OARelatedWork：一个包含来自开放获取来源全文的大规模相关工作章节摘要数据集
translated_abstract: 本文介绍了OARelatedWork：一个用于从开放获取文献生成相关工作的数据集。这是首个用于相关工作生成的大规模多文档摘要数据集，包含完整的相关工作章节以及被引论文的全文。其验证集和测试集的构建方式确保每篇源论文都可以获取全文，从而能够对基于全文的相关工作生成进行可控评估。该数据集包含来自多个领域的94,450篇论文。通过OARelatedWork，我们旨在推动该领域从仅基于摘要生成相关工作章节的部分内容，转向基于所有可用内容生成完整的相关工作章节。我们 (i) 对广泛的模型进行了基准测试，结果表明合成海量全文上下文对所测试的高性价比大语言模型而言仍是挑战：在我们的语句级评判标准下，GPT-4o-mini基于证据的True率从92.9%下降……
tldr: 本文提出了首个用于相关工作生成的大规模多文档摘要数据集OARelatedWork，包含完整相关工作章节与被引论文全文，并通过基准测试揭示了大语言模型在处理海量全文上下文时仍面临的挑战。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces OARelatedWork, the first large-scale multi-document summarization dataset for related work generation with complete related work sections and full texts of cited papers, and benchmarks models to reveal that synthesizing massive full-text contexts remains challenging for cost-effective LLMs.
